note: Snapshot for non-EU/visa-applicant international admissions as of ~2026-09-08. Most A.Y. 2026/27 university application windows for non-EU students closed between Feb–Jul 2026; many portals still support Universitaly/enrolment for already-admitted candidates. A.Y. 2027/28 is only newly opening at a few universities (notably Padua from 15 Sep 2026). Status reflects whether new applications from non-EU students residing abroad are currently accepted; residual EU/resident-only rounds are not counted as open. Individual programme calls can differ—always re-check the cited source.
